verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents item statuses (Active, Resolved, Muted, Archived) and a designated item Owner, which covers assigning an owner, resolving, and ignoring (via Muted). The pack has no evidence of a time-based snooze or of resolved items automatically reopening when they regress. missing for 10: documented snooze capability, documented automatic reopen of resolved items on regression, independent or hands-on corroboration of the triage workflow.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can triage issues — assign an owner, resolve, ignore, or snooze — and the platform reopens a resolved issue automatically when it regresses

citations.quote: There are four statuses: Active, Resolved, Muted, and Archived.
Items can have a specific Rollbar user designated as the Owner of an item.
